architecture.summary: SO-08 gives BillingState a plan, free with memberLimit 5 or team without a limit, and enforces the 5 seats of a free organization in OrganizationAdministration.sendInvitation(): the active members with product access and the pending invitations, from complete reads, refused at the limit with limit-reached, and one send of an organization at a time in the process. The change record, the audit event, and a 409 notice without a link carry the refusal; Members shows N of 5 seats used; the portal JSON gives plan and memberLimit, and the portal accepts team. Components, dependency edges, public modules, containers, and deployment stay the same. The registry draws the plan read of the portal request and the plan and member-fact reads of the member read.
